shadows.name: notice
shadows.purpose: Separates transient notices from the current surface.

motion.name: cover-hover
motion.purpose: Small cover lift, only without a reduced-motion preference.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The principal action in a form or dialog.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:var(--font-body, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:16px;font-weight:650;padding:10px 15px;border:1px solid var(--border,#28282e);border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent,#e8e8ec);color:var(--on-accent,#141417);cursor:pointer}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--accent,#e8e8ec)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e8e8ec);outline-offset:4px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:var(--font-body, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:16px;padding:10px 15px;border:1px solid var(--border,#28282e);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel,#1c1c20);color:var(--text,#e8e8ec);cursor:pointer}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--panel-2,#232328)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e8e8ec);outline-offset:4px}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}

components.name: Labeled search field
components.description: Persistent labels accompany search and account fields.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Search games<input type="search" placeholder="Search your collection"></label>
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;color:var(--text,#e8e8ec);font-family:var(--font-body, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:13px;font-weight:600}.ds-field input{font:inherit;font-size:16px;color:inherit;background:var(--panel,#1c1c20);border:1px solid var(--border,#28282e);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;min-width:0}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e8e8ec);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Platform select
components.description: Labeled native filtering with the same field geometry.
components.css: .ds-select{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;color:var(--text,#e8e8ec);font-family:var(--font-body, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:13px;font-weight:600}.ds-select select{font:inherit;font-size:16px;color:inherit;background:var(--panel,#1c1c20);border:1px solid var(--border,#28282e);border-radius:8px;padding:12px}.ds-select select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e8e8ec);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Game card
components.description: A portrait cover and compact title form one interactive target.
components.css: .ds-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;width:165px;padding:0;text-align:left;border:0;background:none;color:var(--text,#e8e8ec);font-family:var(--font-body, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-cover{display:grid;place-items:center;aspect-ratio:3/4;width:100%;border:1px solid var(--border,#28282e);border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel-2,#232328);color:var(--muted,#a4a4ae);font-size:56px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:5px}.ds-card strong{font-size:14px;line-height:1.4;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-platform{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#a4a4ae)}.ds-card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e8e8ec);outline-offset:7px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-cover{transition:transform 140ms ease}.ds-card:hover .ds-cover{transform:translateY(-3px)}}

components.name: Application navigation
components.description: A compact family header separates context from account access.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;min-height:76px;padding:16px 32px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#28282e);background:var(--rail,#0f0f12);color:var(--text,#e8e8ec);font-family:var(--font-body, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-nav a{font-size:20px;font-weight:750;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.ds-divider{height:22px;width:1px;background:var(--border,#28282e)}.ds-nav button{margin-left:auto;font:inherit;padding:10px 15px;border:1px solid var(--border,#28282e);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel,#1c1c20);color:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav button:hover{background:var(--panel-2,#232328)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e8e8ec);outline-offset:4px}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e8e8ec);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:720px){.ds-nav{padding:14px 18px;gap:12px}}

components.name: Controller choices
components.description: Stacked choices make filtering operable without a native select popup.
components.css: .ds-choices{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font-family:var(--font-body, "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-choices button{font:inherit;text-align:left;min-height:44px;padding:10px 15px;border:1px solid var(--border,#28282e);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel,#1c1c20);color:var(--text,#e8e8ec);cursor:pointer}.ds-choices button:hover{background:var(--panel-2,#232328)}.ds-choices button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--text,#e8e8ec);color:var(--panel,#1c1c20)}.ds-choices button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#e8e8ec);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
RomM uses the existing Silo plugin family's operational visual language. The
interface is quiet, compact and content-led: game covers and titles supply its
identity, while the surrounding controls remain familiar across the library,
account forms and player.

Dark and light surfaces share the same geometry. Clear labels, visible focus
and explicit state text support touch, keyboard and controller use. The player
retains this control language while giving the game the remaining viewport.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic Silo colors with coherent dark and light fallbacks.
One bundled type family for headings, content and controls.
Cover-led grids and compact, labeled fields.
Neutral selected controls, named dialogs and explicit progress status.

rules.name: The Theme Alias Rule
rules.body: Reuse the existing semantic aliases so foreground, background and borders change as a coherent theme.

rules.name: The Inverted Selection Rule
rules.body: A selected controller choice uses the text color as its background and the surface color as its foreground. Selection is also expressed through `aria-pressed`.

rules.name: The Title First Rule
rules.body: In a game detail, the title precedes normal platform metadata. Platform information is not an uppercase kicker above the heading.

rules.name: The Flat Control Rule
rules.body: Preserve tonal hover states and the visible focus outline; ordinary buttons do not need ornamental shadows.

dos: Do use Silo's semantic color aliases and its bundled font family.
Do keep covers portrait, titles wrapping and metadata below the title.
Do preserve explicit labels, named dialogs and visible keyboard focus.
Do use neutral inversion together with a semantic selected state.
Do keep the game stage dominant and progress text visible.
donts: Don't introduce a competing decorative palette or display face.
Don't use a glyph in place of the established text close control.
Don't promote platform metadata into an uppercase eyebrow.
Don't communicate error, selection or pending progress through color alone.
